name: Keyframes
source:
The story is centered around you, and your last couple of years in college!

Campus life has been relatively well for you with your two best friends by your side, but after attending a kick-back celebration in the spring semester of your second year— you find the rest of your days filled with dumb hijinks, wholesome instances, and sometimes straight up ridiculous scenarios. And it’s all because of the three guys you happened to meet at that party.

Good or bad, things start to change and the only thing you can do is experience it as it happens.

[from [url=https://rainslices.itch.io/keyframes-spring-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事围绕你，以及你大学生活的最后几年展开！

有两位挚友相伴，你的校园生活一直还算顺利。但在大二春季学期参加一场轻松的小聚会后，接下来的日子便充满了傻气的闹剧、温暖的瞬间，有时甚至是荒唐透顶的状况。这一切，都要归功于你在那场聚会中偶然结识的三个男生。

无论好坏，事情开始改变，而你唯一能做的，就是亲身经历这一切。

[摘自[url=https://rainslices.itch.io/keyframes-spring-demo]itch.io[/url]]
